The Eagles, led by 9th-year head coach [[Pat Kelsey]], played their home games at the [[Winthrop Coliseum]] in [[Rock Hill, South Carolina]] as members of the [[Big South Conference]]. They finished the season 23–2, 17–1 in [[2020–21 Big South Conference men's basketball season|Big South Play]] to finish as regular season champions. They defeated [[2020–21 High Point Panthers men's basketball team|High Point]], [[2020–21 Longwood Lancers men's basketball team|Longwood]], and [[2020–21 Campbell Fighting Camels basketball team|Campbell]] to be champions of the [[2021 Big South Conference men's basketball tournament|Big South tournament]]. They received the Big South’s automatic bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2020–21 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Winthrop Eagles men's basketball team|Eagles]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 24–10, 15–3 in Big South play to finish as Big South regular season co-champions, alongside [[2019–20 Radford Highlanders men's basketball team|Radford]]. Due to tiebreakers, they received the #2 seed in the [[2020 Big South Conference men's basketball tournament|Big South tournament]]. They defeated the #7 seed [[2019–20 USC Upstate Spartans men's basketball team|USC Upstate]] in the quarterfinals, 106–70.{{Cite news|url=https://winthropeagles.com/news/2020/3/5/mens-basketball-hot-shooting-eagles-cruise-into-semfiinals-with-106-70-win-over-upstate.aspx|title=Hot Shooting Eagles Cruise Into Semifinals With 106–70 Win Over Upstate|work=Winthrop University Athletics|date=March 5, 2020|accessdate=December 15, 2020|language=en}} In the semifinals, they defeated the #3 seed [[2019–20 Gardner–Webb Runnin' Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gardner–Webb]], 78–66, to clinch their spot in the Big South tournament championship game.{{Cite news|url=https://bigsouthsports.com/news/2020/3/6/mens-basketball-no-2-winthrop-downs-no-3-gardner-webb-advances-to-title-game.aspx|title=No. 2 Winthrop Downs No. 3 Gardner-Webb, Advances to Title Game|work=Big South Conference|date=March 6, 2020|accessdate=December 15, 2020|language=en}} There, they matched up against the #5 seed [[2019–20 Hampton Pirates men's basketball team|Hampton]], winning 76–68, earning the Big South's automatic bid into the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.heraldonline.com/sports/college/big-south/winthrop-university/article241010956.html|title=NCAA BOUND! Winthrop wins Big South tournament to earn coveted postseason bid|work=Rock Hill Herald|date=March 8, 2020|accessdate=December 15, 2020|language=en}} However, the NCAA Tournament would be cancelled
